_meta.notes: Read from the primary MOE and SEAB pages, opened in full, on 2026-11-11. Subject levels follow SEAB's 2027 syllabus lists for school candidates: Music is G1 and G3 with no G2, Drama is G3 only, and Economics carries an earlier subject code so it is not new. Grading follows the SEAB SEC page. The national picture, not a promise about any one school. Schools run subsets, and the subjects marked selected are offered only at schools approved to run them. MOE gives no dates or marks for a change of level, only that schools decide at appropriate junctures, so the juncture lines say that and no more. MOE publishes no link between a lower secondary level and a Sec 3 subject; the sec3 lines state only which levels each Sec 3 subject exists at. Teachers can trim the list to their school in the teacher layer. No syllabus codes are shown to students. Third languages (MOELC, PSLE gated) and MTL B (discontinued from the 2024 Sec 1 cohort) are deliberately not planner rows.

G3.name: General 3
G3.plain: The most demanding of the three levels.

groups.label: Science
groups.note: At G2, Science is taken as a pair. Physics, Chemistry and Biology as single subjects are G3 only.
groups.lowerNote: One Science in Sec 1 and 2. In Sec 3 it becomes a pair, or single sciences.

groups.label: Humanities
groups.note: At G2 and G3, you take Social Studies with one Humanities elective. You can add a full Humanities subject. At G1, Humanities is Social Studies with one Humanities Exposure Module, not examined.
groups.lowerNote: In Sec 1 and 2, each Humanities subject has its own level. At G1, Humanities is Social Studies and the Humanities Exposure Modules, not examined.

groups.label: Common Curriculum
groups.note: No levels. About a third of your week.

subjects.name: Higher Mother Tongue
subjects.note: AL 1 or 2 in PSLE Mother Tongue qualifies from 2026. So does a Distinction or Merit in PSLE Higher Mother Tongue. Schools can offer it to others.

sec3.G2: Additional Mathematics exists at G2 and G3. Your school decides who takes it.
sec3.G3: Additional Mathematics exists at G2 and G3. Your school decides who takes it.

subjects.name: Music
subjects.note: Offered at G1 and G3. The SEC has no G2 Music.

subjects.name: Economics

subjects.name: Computing

sec1.note: Humanities levels can move from Sec 2.

sec2.up: Every subject here can move now, Humanities included.

sec3.note: Levels can still change, with your school. Grade targets start to matter.

sec4.note: This year is about your results.
